quotes.text: "marking should add the message size once"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: MarkPendingRemoval compares the requested mark with the existing nonempty pendingRemoval property before changing expungedBytes. A first mark adds the offline size, an unmark subtracts it and repeated same-state calls return without another delta. ApplyRetentionSettings can revisit the same offline headers, which explains the guard. The test directly checks these transition/repetition results; it does not test database failure or atomic flag/count persistence. Two new property assertions omit messages. No test or native IMAP operation ran.
title: IMAP pending-removal byte accounting follows flag transitions
